tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"Can a refund be adjusted or increased after it has already been paid? What policy applies to requests for a refund amount above the amount paid for the returned item, or for an extra discretionary amount?"}

messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/return", "title": "Items must be returned first", "text": "The shop refunds only units it has received back, as shown by its own return records, never by a statement of the customer or the assistant.
